summary: Completed backend regression and desktop/mobile UI testing for authentication, subject learning, quiz feedback, progress, and navigation.
action_items: Replace default JWT_SECRET and test-suite BASE_URL fallbacks with fail-fast environment configuration before production.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses a fallback JWT secret, which weakens token security when configuration is missing.
Frontend lesson/quiz requests have no explicit loading or error state; network failures can leave the user on a blank lesson/quiz view.
seed_data_creation: Created one uniquely named UI registration learner; no seeded production records modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth, registration, Google demo auth, subject dashboard, math lesson, quiz correct answer, AI explanation, progress map, logout, and mobile menu were tested. Other subject-specific lessons and invalid API payloads remain untested.
rca of the issue: No functional failures reproduced. Code review risks are configuration fallback security and missing client-side request error/loading handling; neither blocked the tested flows. Google auth and seeded subject/quiz content are MOCKED/DEMO as specified; explanation used the configured Emergent LLM path during the browser run.
